title: Skepfield: a calm beehive logic puzzle for iPhone

meta.description: Skepfield is a calm beehive logic puzzle for iPhone: one hive per plot, no two touching, and numbered stones count the hives around them. No ads, no tracking.
meta.og:title: Skepfield: a calm beehive logic puzzle
meta.og:description: One hive per plot. Numbered field stones count the hives around them. No ads, no tracking, a free season and a daily field. Coming soon to the App Store.
meta.og:image:alt: Skepfield: Find the one place each hive belongs. Beside the title, a Spring field of crop plots with straw hives, crossed-out cells and two numbered stones.
